pooltool
========

Parts of the OpenBilliards physics kernel are derived from pooltool,
main @ 9a8abfe0da4c3b588dd7779e7f8530123170e742 (v0.6.0-39-g9a8abfe),
https://github.com/ekiefl/pooltool

Copyright (c) Evan Kiefl and contributors.
Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (see LICENSE-Apache-2.0.txt
next to this file, or http://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0).

The derived code was translated to Rust and JavaScript and modified by the
OpenBilliards authors. It is compiled into the physics kernel binaries (the
WebAssembly kernel pool_wasm_bg.wasm and the pool_py extension module of the
openbilliards wheels) and mirrored in the table geometry of the web app
(web/scene/table.js, web/scene/cuestick.js). The list of derived files is in
THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md at the root of the OpenBilliards source tree.

pooltool is described in:
  Kiefl, E. (2024). Pooltool: A Python package for realistic billiards
  simulation. Journal of Open Source Software, 9(101), 7301.
  https://doi.org/10.21105/joss.07301
